visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand holds a colorful 'Toy Story' themed event ticket featuring Woody, Buzz, and Aliens against a blurred asphalt street background. A young boy in a blue t-shirt and lime green shorts walks ahead of the camera. (2) The scene shifts to the exterior of an old brick building at Yongle Market, adorned with a large neon-style sign that reads 'Dadaocheng Vintage Toy Shop' and various Disney Pixar character cutouts. (3) A massive inflatable 'Little Green Man' alien is perched on the building's balcony, waving. A young girl in a blue floral dress and sunglasses is seen pointing towards the inflatable while smiling excitedly. (4) Inside a toy shop, various Toy Story themed items are showcased, including a Hamm piggy bank, a Slinky Dog toy, and a highly customized gaming PC case featuring Alien fans and Toy Story decals. (5) The narrator shows off three gold-colored commemorative coins in his hand, then points towards a visitor center sign with an 'i' symbol. A young boy and girl are seen entering the center. (6) The children participate in a stamp rally, pressing large character stamps like Buzz Lightyear and Forky onto a paper map. The camera captures close-ups of the stamps and their corresponding characters on the map. (7) Outside in a bustling street, the group encounters a giant pink inflatable Lotso bear. The children pose for photos in front of the character while holding their completed stamp maps. (8) The video concludes with the children buying peanut roll ice cream from a traditional street stall. The vendor is shown scraping peanut blocks and wrapping the ice cream rolls, which the children then eat.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track begins with high-tempo, upbeat electronic background music featuring strong synthesized drum beats. An adult male narrator speaks in an energetic and friendly tone, introducing the location. Faint ambient city sounds like traffic hum are present in the background. (2) A sharp percussive 'thud' sound occurs as a stamp is pressed down, followed by the high-pitched, excited laughter of children. The music continues seamlessly, and the boy's voice is heard articulating names of characters with high clarity. (3) The environment shifts to a slightly more resonant indoor space, indicated by a subtle change in vocal reverb as the group enters the visitor center. The narrator interacts with staff, and the sound of paper being handled is clearly audible over the music. (4) Transitioning back outside, the background noise floor rises with the chatter of a crowd and distant wind gusts. A 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies a fast visual transition. The children's voices are energetic as they cheer and describe the stickers they received. (5) The final phase is characterized by the rhythmic scraping of a peanut block at a food stall. The narrator asks questions about flavors, and the children reply with high valence. The music remains a consistent, driving force through to the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This family vlog aims to document and promote a visit to the 'Dadaocheng Vintage Toy Shop' event celebrating the 30th anniversary of Toy Story. By showing the interactive stamp rally, themed decorations, and local food, it provides a guide for families looking for weekend activities in Taipei.
